data.name: Mumu: 3D Desktop Mummy
data.detailed_description:
[h1]Mumu — 3D Desktop Mummy Companion[/h1]

📖 Story

Three thousand years ago, an orphan by the Nile carried more sorrow than any should bear. The Forgotten God of Mercy chose him as a "Soul Keeper." He was granted eternal life — and with it, a blessing and a curse: to touch is to take away another's pain. Those he touches are freed from their grief — but he carries it all alone. Now he is sealed behind the screen, waiting for someone to keep a place for him on their desktop. A glance when you're tired. A word when you're alone. That is why he exists.

You are never alone.

🐾 About the Game

Mumu is a 3D companion desktop pet — raise your own little Mummy and enjoy a heartwarming companionship in the garden, under the stars, and among the clouds.

🎮 What You Can Do

  • 🐾 Raise your own little Mummy desktop pet
  • 🌸 Plant flowers and play Kitty Quiz in the chat garden
  • 🎣 Piggy Fishing · World Tree Creative Painting · Red Panda Merchant Trading
  • 🌊 Cloud fortune-telling, exploring the unknown and your questions
  • 🖼️ Explore thousands of quiz questions and discover hidden constellation surprises
  • 🏠 Customize your chat interface skin and create your own desktop style
  • 🚀 Grab Mumu and fling him across your desktop — real gravity physics, bouncing off the screen edges, spinning back to you

✨ Features

  • Heartwarming art style + dynamic pet interactions
  • Gardening + Fishing + Painting = triple the fun
  • Cloud Fortune × Plum Blossom Yi Jing divination
  • 🌌 Hidden constellation and starry sky easter eggs
  • Lives on your desktop, ready to interact anytime

🧩 How to Access Every Feature

After launching the game, Mumu will appear in the corner of your desktop (as a system tray icon).

Right-click the Mumu icon in the system tray → choose "Chat 💬" → the chat window opens.

Gardening, Kitty Quiz, Piggy Fishing, World Tree Creative Painting, Red Panda Merchant Trading, Cloud fortune-telling, thousands of quiz questions, and chat skin switching — all of these are inside the chat window. Click the tabs at the top to switch between them.

Other system tray menu items: Star River 🌌 (toggle and colors), Constellation ⭐ (constellations and stardust), Pose (Auto/Sit/Lie), Window Size 📐, Star Clock ✨ (focus & rest timer), Check-in, Language 🌐.

🎁 Launch Bonus

On first launch, you'll receive the Sirius constellation and 100 stardust — light up your very first golden galaxy ✨

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel(R)Core(TM） i3
  • Memory: 4 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 620
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: Internet required for text-to-speech voice; offline pet mode works without.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel(R)Core(TM）i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: any PC with sound
  • Additional Notes: Internet required for text-to-speech voice; offline pet mode works without.
